scale.interpretation: Issuer long-term opportunity claim is promotional forward-looking evidence, not independent demand verification or a timed FY2035 spending forecast. Do not confuse the separate1trillion installed data-center infrastructure stock with1trillion annual spending. Platform revenue categories and TAM categories are not one-to-one.
constraints: 30%,50%,70% share coordinates are illustrative analyst constraints, not observed or independently established plausible shares.
Current78.0% DataCenter/17.1%Gaming mix held constant is a diagnostic, not forecast;90%DataCenter is an alternative mix stress.

A share above100% of stated systems TAM exposes either need for future TAM expansion, different category scope, higher software/services mix or a revenue-path revision. It does not prove the oldTAM is a hard ceiling.
Broad trillion opportunity includes speculative autonomous/Omniverse markets; cannot lend that total to a mostlyDataCenter forecast without separate segment cases.
No dated bottom-up hyperscaler/customer capex and NVIDIA capture schedule verifies feasibility; this remains a material validation gap.

awards.classification: Post-freeze source extraction and gross exposure quantification; original value not changed
awards.method: Reported unit counts constrain gross share exposure, and contemporaneous note gives option intrinsic values/strikes/lives. Gross units valued at model price are a sensitivity, not observed market fair value. Grant-date average fair values and unearned book expense are not interchangeable with current claim value. Reserved shares for future grants are not outstanding claims.
awards.noDoubleCounting: A full legacy claim deduction must first remove the corresponding future legacy amortization from projected operating expenses, retaining all future NEW grant/replacement compensation cost. Alternatively use a consistently forecast fully diluted share path with equivalent compensation treatment. Aggregate margin forecasts do not isolate legacy amortization, vesting/performance probabilities or tax effects; do not apply both whole-unit dilution and untouched legacy expense. Unrecognized compensation totals cannot simply be added back at face value.
awards.remainingGap: Need grant-cohort vesting/service schedules, performance conditions, legacy/new grant expense split, forfeitures, actual option counts, valuation-date price and option volatility/dividend inputs, plus tax treatment and cover-date rollforward. Therefore these cases still do not contain a verified net legacy-claim bridge.

method2024.classification: Post-freeze methodological and source-completeness addendum, no original values changed

bridgePrecision.interpretation: 70% was declared rounded judgment, not exact bridge; show added revenue rather than presenting rounding as immaterial.

method2024.scaleCaveat: No dated independent TAM or customer-capex budget reconstruction validates these final-year sales. They are implied scenario scales, not demonstrated addressable demand. Bottom-up customer deployment, replacement cycles, inference economics and alternative-silicon share are required to validate them.
method2024.capitalMechanism: Maturity can demand larger working-capital buffers, capacity reservations/prepayments, system/networking mix, support/cloud infrastructure and replacement/obsolescence investment. These mechanisms could reduce sales/capital. The exact3to0.6962path is an algebraic competitive-return constraint, NOT measured proof these mechanisms reach that magnitude. No invented fabs are assumed.

knownCommitments.sections: Notes Commitments and Contingencies; MD&A Liquidity
knownCommitments.treatment: Operating inventory and cloud/R&D commitments belong in future operating costs and working-capital/investment timing; do not deduct20.7bn wholesale as debt in addition. Base first-year net reinvestment14.22bn is an undifferentiated sales/capital proxy, not a line-item reconciliation to these commitments or PPE guidance. Validate by detailed dated cash-flow schedule in a future version.
